source: Live observation via Claude-in-Chrome MCP, browser='bonsall', UA=user's normal Chrome
method: Navigate to representative URL, read network requests, inspect DOM globals via JS, capture screenshots
evidence_basis: observed = directly captured via browser tools; inferred = visible patterns suggest but not directly observed; not_observed = listed for completeness, not visited this session

page_types.purpose: Top-of-funnel: category nav, promotional tiles, weekly ad lead-in, store selector
page_types.evidence_notes: Initial home fetch via Bash curl with custom UA. 296KB HTML. 12 top-level dept nav links visible plus utility nav (Garden Centers, Equipment Repair, Propane, Find a Store, Help, Rewards, Gift Cards, The Dirt blog).

page_types.purpose: CMS-curated department pages with feature tiles, seasonal promos, links into PLPs
page_types.evidence_notes: Pattern visible in homepage nav links. URL pattern /category/<slug>/ separate from /products/<slug>/. Not directly visited this session.

page_types.purpose: Browse and filter SKUs within a category. Faceted search with brand/special/style/gender filters.
page_types.rendering: SSR shell, hydrated by Constructor.io React SDK for product grid + facets
page_types.evidence_notes: Visited /products/lawn-garden/. 31 product cards rendered. Every facet element has cio-* class prefix (Constructor.io React SDK). Window globals include catalogCategoryName, headerSearchServerSideViewModel, triggerProductBrowseActivity, clickToViewPriceCuratedProduct.

page_types.purpose: Single SKU detail with pricing, variants, store inventory check, ship-to-home, BOPIS
page_types.rendering: SSR, Episerver. JSON-LD Product schema embedded. og:image meta tags carry real image URLs.
page_types.evidence_notes: Visited and captured. JSON-LD has @type=Product with name/brand/description/offers[]. Real fields: SKU=9390357, MPN=190424, name, brand 'Grab & Go', price $14.99 USD, availability InStock. UI shows TWO product IDs: SKU# (POS) and MPN# (manufacturer part number) — dual-keyed item master confirmed in production.
page_types.schema_quirk: JSON-LD 'image' field returns the .NET ToString() of their ImageModel class instead of a URL. Real images are in og:image meta tags. Parser-side workaround needed.
observed_third_party_calls: Listrak personalization rule fetch (3 rule files)
GA4 enhanced ecommerce view_item with item_id=FOGR_190424 (vendor code, not POS SKU)
Bing UET, Pinterest, TheTradeDesk, Facebook Pixel

page_types.purpose: Browse all 47 stores, search by ZIP/city, link into per-store detail pages
page_types.rendering: SSR with full store data injected as JS object literal in inline <script>
page_types.evidence_notes: 47 stores in window.stores array. Every store has number, storeName, address, city/state/zip, phone, lat/lng, comingSoon flag, storeDetailsLink, facebookStorePage. Also window.chooseAStoreServerSideViewModel with storeUpdateMessage, selectedStoreNumber, murdochsRegionDistanceThreshold (300mi), freeInStoreComingSoon. No XHR needed — entire dataset embedded server-side.
observed_third_party_calls: CookieYes consent banner (full audit table loaded)
GA4, Bing UET, Application Insights, Microsoft Clarity
Custom internal AWS App Runner service: mbzaubiphz.us-west-2.awsapprunner.com/events/* — POST events, 503 in observation but 503 may be deliberate response (event captured, no body needed)

page_types.purpose: Per-store hours, amenities (fuel, propane, feed dock, boots), manager, services, store-specific events
page_types.evidence_notes: Linked from /stores/ via store.storeDetailsLink field. 47 detail pages exist. Hours and amenities are NOT in the /stores/ window.stores payload — they live on the per-store page. A separate per-store crawl would be needed for full location master detail.
